title: Australian Taxation Office Management of Small Business Collectable Debt
summary: The audit objective was to assess the effectiveness of the Australian Taxation Office’s management of small business collectable debt.
excerpt: What did we find? The ATO’s management of collectable small business debt risks is partly effective. The ATO’s self-assessment is that the risk of unacceptable levels of small business debt is out of tolerance. What did we recommend? There were eight recommendations relating to performance measures, benchmarks, communication, and better use of data. The ATO agreed to all eight recommendations.
